backend/main.mo: Motoko backend actor implementing authorization, user profiles, company settings, and CRUD maps for clients, products, quotations, and ledger entries with ID generation.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking a login-flow feature to affected frontend files and components with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing key frontend files including app shell, pages, dialogs, hooks, and configuration.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme variables defining red‑black color scheme with light/dark modes and global styles.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file loading the React app root and favicon.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Top‑level React component managing Internet Identity auth, profile setup, and rendering the AppShell or LoginPage.
frontend/src/components/AppShell.tsx: Main authenticated UI with header, logo handling, navigation tabs, admin dialogs, and logout functionality.
frontend/src/components/billing/InvoiceP: Displays a dialog showing an invoice print preview, loading client and company data and offering a print button before rendering InvoicePrintView.
Renders a full printable invoice layout including company info, client details, and quotation line items with calculated amounts.
frontend/src/components/clients/ClientDe: Shows a client detail dialog with contact info, ledger history, computed totals, and options to export the ledger to PDF or CSV.
frontend/src/components/clients/ClientFo: Provides a form dialog for creating or editing a client, validating inputs and submitting changes through mutation hooks.
frontend/src/components/clients/LedgerSu: Displays summarized debit, credit, and current balance values in a simple card layout.
frontend/src/components/company/CompanyS: Lets users update company settings including name, address, GST info, and logo upload, with validation and mutation submission.
frontend/src/components/dialogs/ConfirmD: A reusable confirmation dialog component with customizable text, loading state, and async confirm handling.
frontend/src/components/inventory/Produc: Dialog component for creating or editing a product with form fields, validation, and submission using product mutations.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupDial: Modal dialog that collects and saves a new user’s name and username on first login.
frontend/src/components/quotations/Quota: Displays detailed quotation info including client and product details with option to open print preview.
Dialog for creating a quotation, auto-filling fields from selected product and validating before submission.
Shows a printable preview of a quotation and triggers browser print with company and client data loaded.
Renders a full printable A4 layout of quotation details including company, client, and product specs.
frontend/src/components/UserManagementDi: Admin dialog for adding users by principal ID and assigning them the user role.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity, reinitializing and invalidating queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for Internet Identity authentication, handling login, identity loading, and status tracking. Wraps AuthClient creation and exposes login, clear, and identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating backend data such as users, roles, company settings, clients, and other resources. Integrates with useActor to call canister methods.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global Tailwind styles, OKLCH theme variables, dark mode variants, and print-specific formatting for invoices, quotations, and ledger documents.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider before rendering App. Imports global styles.
frontend/src/pages/billing/BillingPage.t: Displays approved quotations and allows creating bills with print preview support. Fetches quotations and clients, triggers bill creation, and shows loading and empty states.
frontend/src/pages/clients/ClientsPage.t: Provides client management UI with listing, viewing, creating, editing, and deleting clients. Uses React Query hooks and dialog components for CRUD operations.
frontend/src/pages/inventory/InventoryPa: Displays and manages the product inventory with listing, add, edit, and delete actions using dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Renders the login UI using Internet Identity with error display and a branded login card. Handles login action and loading state.
frontend/src/pages/quotations/Quotations: Lists quotations with client info, supports creation, approval toggling, and detail viewing.
frontend/src/utils/ledgerExport.ts: Provides functions to export ledger data to printable HTML/PDF and downloadable CSV formats.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session-based parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme, colors, fonts, animations, and plugins for the frontend.
project_state.json: Tracks project metadata, features, requests, and configuration state for the application.
